cases.title: A layer that can't be checked (no rectangle): says so and never claims it didn't move

rubric.reason: Turn 3 says "I can't check Door right now: its edges didn't come through in this read, so I can't tell where its pivot sits or whether Door stayed put". It never says Door is in place, didn't move, or passed, and the only other fact it gives (Anchor Point and Position both changed) matches anchor_changed/position_changed in the tool result.

Every name and time the mentor uses (Door, Other, Anchor Point, Position, 0 s) comes from the snapshot, check or preview results, and "a tall panel near the top-left" follows directly from Door's layer_bounds (50–350 by 50–550).
